nodes.claim: The theorem-correct rooted-star representation is orient then center: C_6 O_l S_l d_1.
Every nonzero centered one-star displacement on the open side-two four-cube has positive spill spectrum {(37/33)^3,(391/239)^2}.
The frozen spill-aware free-energy inequality gives an admissible coefficient 0.9683231479404556 at the upper split.
The oriented four- and eight-link finite systems have four and seven zero-spill modes respectively.
The pair, four-link, and eight-link KKT forms, nullities, and generalized characteristic polynomials are certified over the rationals.
An exact spectral atlas is available for growing compact, thin, branched, boundary-touching, periodic, and winding polymer families.
Relative cohomology identifies the zero-spill sector and separates exact, gauge, harmonic, and flux modes.
The multi-star spill form factors through a boundary trace, or its positive rank and total cost are boundary-sized on a declared polymer class.
The zero/low-spill sector has a nonvanishing uniform projection onto the displacement cone of the declared bad event.
A compatible linear repair has complete internal/external action accounting, true link-fiber Jacobian, and net bulk-minus-boundary free energy beating polymer entropy.
The linear repair lifts to a finite gauge-covariant SU(2) link map with uniform BCH, chart, topology, Haar, Jacobian, injectivity, and multiplicity control.
The nonlinear repair yields a boundary-history-, volume-, and cutoff-uniform normalized conditional partition ratio and a strict state-weighted bad-kernel ceiling.
The one-scale kernel estimate persists along a positivity-preserving RG trajectory with a positive physical-length rate.
A nontrivial continuum pure Yang-Mills measure exists, satisfies OS hypotheses, and the decaying observable core is dense in the vacuum complement.
The reconstructed Hamiltonian has the Clay-required positive mass gap.
